text:
sasha: Heads up — EU keystore retention policy was tightened by security this morning and firewall egress rules were narrowed at the same time. Seeing a bunch of provisioning failures for gpu warm-pools in eu-west-1, NAT gw 1->connection exhaustion, and an unexpected audit-log re-ingest cost spike.

mohit: I can see the failed boot logs — nodes can't reach our keystore endpoint over privatelink, falling back to control-plane and timing out. Errors: `keystore:401` then `timeout: connect` in bootstrap.

leah: @sasha do we have a change ticket/PR that landed this? might need a rollback if impact is that wide.

sasha: security-bot pushed the retention change and firewall ACLs via Terraform about 07:12 UTC. ticket #SEC-2319. They decreased the keystore path TTL and removed a broad NAT egress exception.

security-bot: automated note: Per policy SEC-RET-4, keystore audit blobs retention shortened to 30d; default egress ACL tightened to deny 0.0.0.0/0 except approved endpoints. Change was reviewed by @jamie.

jamie: I approved the ACL narrowing but didn't realize the keystore lives on a regional privatelink endpoint that requires the prior broad egress for legacy warmup flows. My bad.

mohit: The immediate problem: warm-pool nodes attempt keystore handshake during init, failover to public control plane, saturate NAT gw src-ports. Once NAT ports are exhausted other infra traffic (image pulls, telemetry) times out.

leah: Can we short-circuit: 1) re-open ACL to include keystore privatelink CIDR, 2) scale NAT gw or add additional NAT, 3) pause retention re-ingest job that is thrashing S3 -> audit pipeline? Which is fastest?

dan: Fastest is (1) revert ACL to include privatelink CIDR — we can do a targeted terraform apply. (2) Pause re-ingest job is on the audit team, need approval from security.

ops-bot: `runbook apply --target=module.keystore_acls --env=eu-west-1` queued (ops-run-992). Estimated 2m to converge.

security-bot: Note: Reverting ACL without addressing retention re-ingest still leaves audit storage policy noncompliant. Suggest revert ACL as emergency mitigation, then scheduled remediation to update warmup flow to go through privatelink only.

mohit: I'm tailing bootstrap logs: new nodes started coming up ~30s after ops-run-992 applied. We still have a backlog of stalled images because NAT port exhaustion persists until flows drain (~5-10m).

leah: Cost note: audit re-ingest multiplied request volume to audit pipeline when retention shortened (old chunks re-validated). Cloud cost alert fired: predicted +25% for S3 GET and processing this billing cycle. Need a cost mitigation step.

jamie: For cost: we can throttle re-ingest (audit job flag `--reingest-concurrency=2`) and set a short window. I'll open a quick MR to gate it. Also request for a one-off lifecycle rule to move older audit logs to GLACIER-INSTANT for 7d to avoid hot re-access.

dan: Ops plan: 1) emergency ACL revert (done), 2) add an extra nat-gw (scales short-term) — I'll Terraform apply `nat_pool_add`. 3) Request security approval to pause re-ingest for 2 hours. 4) Longer term: update warmup to use privatelink endpoints only and add egress tests in CI.

leah: Who's owning the security approval? I pinged the sec-oncall. @jamie please nudge.

jamie: On it. Sec-oncall responded: approve pause for 2 hours while infra stabilizes. Logged in SEC-EMERG-449.

mohit: Added a temporary `iptables` DNAT on bootstrap host group to direct keystore traffic to privatelink IP as a stopgap for nodes that still fallback to public plane. Not perfect but reduced NAT usage.

ops-bot: `terraform apply` nat_pool_add started (op-1001). Est time 3m.

mohit: NAT scaling completed. New NAT in eu-west-1 attached to route table. Observability: NAT ephemeral port usage back to normal, image pulls recovering.

leah: Cost mitigation summary: jamie to lower re-ingest concurrency + lifecycle roll; dan to add temporary budget alert threshold; security to confirm retention policy justification and timeline.

jamie: MR opened: `audit/reingest: throttle and lifecycle temp` — will merge on sec ack.

security-bot: Acknowledged. Sec-oncall: please maintain audit integrity log of actions; record approvals in SEC-EMERG-449 thread.

dan: Postmortem TODOs: - add automated egress test on change PRs - update keystore privatelink docs - add NAT port usage dashboard and alert - add rollout checklist for retention policy changes.

sasha: thanks all. Immediate impact mitigated. Follow-up meeting 15:30 UTC to lock in remediation timeline.

leah: FYI — billing showed initial spike estimate +$2.2k for this day alone if we don't throttle. Good catch.

jamie: Will follow up with security on why privatelink exception wasn't in the change template.

ops-bot: Reminder: tag all terraform changes with `incident:SEC-EMERG-449` for audit.

sasha: closing the loop — if anyone sees new failures, ping here. Otherwise we'll archive and track in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
